name: brief-to-verified
goal: Hand a repo and a brief; get pass, fail, or inconclusive without trusting last-msg.txt and without writing the user's checkout.
broken_today: dispatch returns when the worker process exits. verify is a later, optional command. A finished task with exit 0 and no outcome.json is a completed-looking run that never verified.
measure: python3 -c "import pathlib,re; t=pathlib.Path('scripts/smart-subagents.sh').read_text(); s=t.find('cmd_dispatch() {'); e=t.find('\\ncmd_', s+10); print(len(re.findall(r'\\bcmd_verify\\b', t[s:e])))"
